rules.ui: English-only, rebuilt Silicon Valley mobile product UI
rules.references: Draft frames and screenshots are direction only; never reuse them as final pixels
rules.cameraZoom: Whole phone rig: scale 0.96 to 2.25, y 0 to -756, x 0, 0.78s, power3.inOut
rules.textEntrance: opacity 0→1, y 24→0, scale .94→1, blur 12px→0, 0.58s, power3.out, phrase stagger 0.18s

shots.title: Minara App 2.0
shots.visual: Centered title on #F7F7F7. Match the draft's restrained type-to-canvas ratio; “2.0” uses #EB53FF → #FF538F → #FF9A32 gradient.
shots.motion: Default phrase blur-pop. “Minara App” lands first, “2.0” follows by 0.18s.
shots.transition: Title holds, then the gradient numerals become the visual energy that releases the logo field.

shots.voiceover: Your ultimate financial agent on your phone.
shots.title: The market converges on one phone
shots.visual: A dense circular field of trading, brokerage and quant product logos rotates around a clean centered phone silhouette; the field expands past frame, revealing the phone in use.
shots.motion: 18 square logo tiles rotate on a tilted reverse loop, then accelerate outward. Flat phone remains the anchor; no Three.js.
shots.transition: Flying tiles resolve into multiple mobile input bars entering the next shot.

shots.title: One question
shots.visual: Oversized iPhone 17 frame. Several input bars fly past; the central bar resolves to “What could move AI stocks this week?”
shots.motion: Use the approved whole-rig camera zoom into the input area, then type the question with a monochrome caret.
shots.transition: Direct cut on submit; no white stretch card, threshold flash, scan lines or afterimage.

shots.voiceover: Get clear market insights in seconds.
shots.title: Answer becomes product structure
shots.visual: The input view immediately becomes an English answer screen. Clean conclusion, supporting data and source chips assemble inside the phone; cropped evidence cards align outside the frame.
shots.motion: Conclusion → data → sources enter with short vertical growth. Components detach and settle into their actual Minara app positions.
shots.transition: Answer components align into a complete mobile page, then the phone recenters.

shots.voiceover: Your pocket financial advisor, wherever you go.
shots.title: From interface to pocket
shots.visual: The completed phone stays legible while the environment changes to a real walking pocket shot supplied externally by the user.
shots.motion: UI motion slows; subtle handheld translation belongs to the external plate, not to the phone UI.
shots.transition: Phone pulls out of the environment and returns to #F7F7F7 as asset icons enter orbit.

shots.voiceover: Stocks, commodities, crypto—one app to trade everything.
shots.title: Every market, one center
shots.visual: BTC, major US equities, commodities and futures symbols orbit one centered mobile product surface.
shots.motion: Three depth bands rotate at different constant speeds; selected icons magnetically dock into market tabs.
shots.transition: Docked assets flatten into a wall of chart panels.

shots.title: Charts
shots.visual: A gapless TradingView-inspired wall of five grayscale market charts, rebuilt as original UI.
shots.motion: Panels rise in two rows; price paths draw left to right with restrained green only for gains.
shots.transition: Chart cells compress into earnings modules.

shots.title: Earnings intelligence
shots.visual: Earnings summary modules: estimate, actual, surprise and transcript takeaway.
shots.motion: Modules grow from baselines with elastic but controlled scale; metrics count once.
shots.transition: Metric blocks reorganize into analyst visualizations.

shots.title: Many views, one decision
shots.visual: Five analysis types fill the frame: treemap, ring, distribution bars, consensus ladder and risk matrix.
shots.motion: Each view enters in a 0.12s stagger and animates only its meaningful data dimension.
shots.transition: Columns extend vertically and become news feeds.

shots.title: News in motion
shots.visual: Three dense columns of English market-news cards with source, timestamp, ticker and one-line headline.
shots.motion: Left and right columns scroll upward; center scrolls downward at a slightly slower rate.
shots.transition: One stock card expands into a trading ticket.

shots.title: Spot order
shots.visual: A clean English spot ticket grows into place with quantity, price, Long, Short and Buy controls; camera favors the Buy action.
shots.motion: Ticket assembles with spring-like height expansion. Cursor moves to Buy using one deliberate arc.
shots.transition: Click becomes a centered network mark.

shots.title: Ondo settlement
shots.visual: Ondo Network logo centered on a dark graphite field with a concise “Generating” system line.
shots.motion: Logo blur-pops in; a #FAFAFA shimmer sweeps over #3F3F46 text at speed 1.
shots.transition: The shimmer extends into two parallel price traces.

shots.voiceover: Or go long and short with perps.
shots.title: Long and short, simultaneously
shots.visual: Split screen: Long on the left, Short on the right. Each side has a large action button and its own chart.
shots.motion: Both 3-second actions run in parallel: Long bends upward while Short bends downward. Buttons and charts grow elastically from their anchors.
shots.transition: The two chart paths straighten into production lines.

shots.title: Automation begins
shots.visual: Five parallel workflow lines carry small order boxes between rule nodes.
shots.motion: Boxes hop slowly from node to node; only active nodes illuminate.
shots.transition: Camera pulls back to reveal full conveyor lanes.

shots.title: Strategy throughput
shots.visual: Five fast parallel conveyor lanes end at acceptance ports. Each accepted box emits green light and a seeded profit value.
shots.motion: Conveyors accelerate; receipts appear once per accepted box using deterministic values, never runtime randomness.
shots.transition: Three accepted boxes rise and become three phones.

shots.title: Compare strategies
shots.visual: Three iPhones rise from the bottom, cropped at mid-body. Each contains one distinct strategy card.
shots.motion: Phones spring upward one by one with consistent 0.16s stagger and no idle wobble.
shots.transition: Cards expand into creator profiles.

shots.title: Choose the operator
shots.visual: Strategy-author cards show avatar, trading experience, AUM and recent return in concise English.
shots.motion: Profiles slide horizontally under a fixed comparison rule; strongest metrics receive one contrast pulse.
shots.transition: The selected center phone scales forward.

shots.title: Run
shots.visual: Camera closes on the center phone's luminous strategy card and wide rounded Run button.
shots.motion: Cursor enters, clicks once; Run changes to Running with a left-to-right state fill.
shots.transition: Running state expands into the autopilot control surface.

shots.voiceover: Autopilot monitors and executes the strategy 24/7.
shots.title: Two cycles on autopilot
shots.visual: Phone on the right shows Minara monitoring trades and P&L. A sun and moon rotate around the screen center; background shifts gray → deep navy → gray.
shots.motion: Exactly two day/night cycles. System events and P&L entries continue while the environment changes.
shots.transition: Second daylight state settles on the control bar.

shots.title: Pause instantly
shots.visual: Whole phone remains visible as the camera zooms to the Stop/Pause control.
shots.motion: Approved camera zoom, then a single cursor click changes Running to Paused.
shots.transition: Content scroll starts immediately from the paused state.

shots.title: Switch strategy
shots.visual: The same phone scrolls upward to reveal the next strategy card.
shots.motion: One upward content scroll; cursor clicks Run and the label becomes Running.
shots.transition: Phone detaches cleanly from #F7F7F7 for environment plates.

shots.title: Environment sequence
shots.visual: Beach, office, home and grass environments supplied/generated externally by the user. Phone remains the consistent focal object.
shots.motion: Environment match-cuts; no internal UI rebuild required for the plates.
shots.transition: Last environment holds while the phone comes forward.

shots.title: The phone stays with you
shots.visual: One persistent phone crosses the same four externally generated places, reinforcing continuity rather than showing new features.
shots.motion: Phone scale and screen orientation remain consistent across match cuts.
shots.transition: Environment drops to #F7F7F7; the word Research appears.

shots.title: Research
shots.visual: Large Research typography over a dense field of rebuilt US equity and futures analysis cards.
shots.motion: Default blur-pop title; cards reveal in low-contrast waves behind it.
shots.transition: Research word shifts out as the card field becomes executable tickets.

shots.title: Trade
shots.visual: Large Trade typography over many order cards. Multiple cursors press Long or Short; profit receipts range from $100 to $100,000.
shots.motion: Deterministic seeded clicks and receipts; each number appears once near its originating card.
shots.transition: Receipts orbit inward and form clock ticks.

shots.title: Automate
shots.visual: A clock begins at 80% of frame height, then contracts by 50%. Behind it, a large P&L curve climbs from lower left to upper right with real volatility.
shots.motion: Clock hands run continuously; curve advances slowly; Buy and Sell markers appear along the path.
shots.transition: Clock contracts into the center of a phone screen.

shots.title: One controlled system
shots.visual: Phone rises from below and settles at center with a subtle breathing scale. Official Minara square logomark installs into the screen; concentric gradient rings converge behind it.
shots.motion: Phone spring-up, one restrained breath, logo blur-pop, rings move inward.
shots.transition: Rings collapse to a quiet brand field.

shots.title: Brand lockup
shots.visual: Official Minara logo with “Minara App 2.0” centered on #F7F7F7.
shots.motion: Logo and phrase enter with the default blur-pop, then hold.
shots.transition: Lockup shifts slightly upward to make room for the promise.

shots.title: Promise
shots.visual: Brand lockup remains. “Your financial intelligence.” appears beneath it with generous spacing.
shots.motion: Single phrase blur-pop; no extra graphic movement.
shots.transition: Final phrase replaces the promise on the same baseline.

shots.title: Final resolve
shots.visual: Final centered stack: official Minara logo, Minara App 2.0, “Your agent.” and “In one app.” Black, white and gray with the approved 2.0 gradient as the only color accent.
shots.motion: Two phrase groups blur-pop 0.18s apart. Hold the final composition through the 0.052s source tail.
shots.transition: End on a clean static hold.
